title: Token embeddings and sinusoidal positional encoding
hints: An embedding lookup is fancy indexing: E[tokens] works for any shape of tokens and returns tokens.shape + (d,).
Build the angle table by broadcasting a (T, 1) column of positions against a (1, d/2) row of inverse frequencies 10000 ** (-np.arange(0, d, 2) / d).

Fill the even columns with np.sin(angles) and the odd columns with np.cos(angles) through the slices pe[:, 0::2] and pe[:, 1::2]. Adding positions is E[tokens] + P[:T], which broadcasts over the batch.
